content: Ndɛb a Yɛsu
Ungö apan, Dweelà a Nzam kàsyen Yɛsu u nsye a ipɔl ntɔn ileŋ kyun'lwɛb.
Ungö mukin udyà myäänà an'kwem an'nà anà mpib an'kwem an'nà, ngyal waa yun'käär.
Un'lwɛɛb kàyàsin tsütsü, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Kya ngye asàkal Mwan a Nzam, swaŋ nkɔŋ yi ibulà mampà. »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàfuur naa: « Bàsön naa: "Kà nà mampà mpɛl anki màfàpà mbuur mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ ndaa yanswà ifàtoo u mun a Nzam". »
Apan, ileŋ kyun'syen u bul in'kyɛɛl, laa kun'si nde udu a ndwà a Nzam,

waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Kya isàkal naa ngye awà Mwan a Nzam, tɔɔmà unsi, ntɔn bàsön naa: "Nde asàswaŋ akyeey ande ntɔn ngye, waa ba bàsawal kan'kɔɔ aba ntɔn làkɔl angye làkɔɔn aböl u nkɔŋ mwɛy". »
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: « Bàsön sye naa: "Ngye asun'lwab anki Mwol, Nzam angye". »
Ileŋ kàfun'syen udu a mɔŋ a bwɛlàbwɛl, waa kun'mɛɛy imfum a mɛɛn byanswà anà làkoo abya,
waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mɛ in'sapà indiir bi byanswà, isàkal naa ngye aman'kömà anà aman'sà làkoo. »
Abun Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Satanà, kyà kunà! Ntɔn bàsön naa: "Ngye asàkömà Mwol Nzam angye anà ngye asàsyääl nde mpɛl". »
Abun, ileŋ waa kàsun'wɛy. Apan sye, akyeey bàyàsin tsütsü apà Yɛsu, waa bun'syäälà.
Nsɛmà a isal a Yɛsu
Mpal kàwem nde naa Ywan Un'düümà kan'bilà bɔlokà, Yɛsu kàkyen Ngalilɛ.
Ungö kàlwomà nde u Nasàlɛr, nde kàkyen Kapɛrnawum kun'kɔɔl a ɛwà, kà itiir a nsi a Zabulɔn anà Nɛftali,
ntɔn ndaa kàkyään ŋangɔɔm Yɛsay yi ikwe:

content.text: « Mɛɛn a Zabulɔn, mɛɛn a Nɛftali,
mbwo a ngyäl a kölàköl, nsi ayà u sim a Yɔrdan lumwɛy, u Ngalilɛ a baar mpa abà Ayudà!
Baar abà bàkäl u nsi a làpib a ukwà,

content: Fà umpal ayin, Yɛsu laa kàsɛmà nde mukyään naa: « Làbuul mpem abɛ: Imwol a du kyan'yàsin tsütsü! »
Yɛsu kan'bel alɔ̈ɔ̈b a nsö a nà
Mpal kàkäl nde muyikyà kun'kɔɔl a ɛwà a Ngalilɛ, nde kàmɛn atɔŋ abɔ̈ɔ̈l, Simɔn bàfàbel Petɔlà anà un'tɔŋ ande Andrɛ, bàmuyitɔɔm an'tɛy u ngyäl, ntɔn ba bàkäl alɔ̈ɔ̈b a nsö.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Yà lan'läb, waa mɛ in'yàlabuul alɔ̈ɔ̈b a baar. »
Apan sye, ba bàsàwɛy an'tɛy, waa bun'läb.
Mpal kàfàsin nde kusà, nde kàmɛn atɔŋ abɔ̈ɔ̈l asin, Zyak anà Ywan, baan a Zɛbeday. Ba bàkäl uboo a bwaar aba anà taaràba Zɛbeday bàmulɔɔnà an'tɛy aba. Yɛsu waa kabel.
Apan sye, ba bàsàwɛy bwaar anà taaràba, waa bun'läb.
Yɛsu wàmuyilɔŋ anà muyikɔɔr
Ungö apan, nde kàyilyaŋà u Ngalilɛ wanswà, waa kàyilɔɔŋà uboo a ndwà a nköŋ aba, muyikyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Imwol anà muyikɔɔr ukyäl banswà anà too lanswà uboo a un'sɛŋ.
Làsaŋ ande làpää u Siri lanswà, waa bun'twäälà abɛy bàkäl anà an'kyal mà ifà ifà: an'dweelà an'be, akweel a nkaaŋ anà ikar, waa kakɔɔr ba banswà.
Iköŋ a baar mbɔɔn bàfü Ngalilɛ, anà itiir a An'bul Kwem, anà Yɛlusàlɛm, Yuday anà sim a Yɔrdan waa bàyun'labà.
